api.GammaDyadCoupling(factors: PWFactors, io: Constructs the registered unweighted Gamma channel. Integer block_size must be 1..16. Checks original physical grid, PW ordering/momenta, zero k/q, species and one-based atom maps, radial-table volume, D, and exact placed-projector identity at every atom. Input arrays remain borrowed and must not be mutated afterward.
api.moments(left, right, coefficient=None): Finite two-dimensional arrays (npw,nleft), (npw,nright). Optional finite C(nleft,nright). Returns complex density(nr) in bohr^-3 and positive atom-major gradient(ndof) in Ry/bohr for X=L C R†. None is exact identity only for equal column counts; no identity allocation. Zero-column inputs represent the zero dyad.
api.potential_action(field, vectors): Finite field(nr) and vectors(npw,nvector), both possibly complex; returns complex full-PW shape-preserving local-potential action, streamed in block_size columns. Field is in Ry. Zero columns supported.
api.ionic_action(direction, vectors): Finite complex direction(ndof), atom-major, and vectors(npw,nvector); returns positive g(direction) vectors. Uses existing GammaIonicAction.prepare and 1..16-column apply API. Direction is linear, never conjugated. Zero columns supported.
api.GammaGradientReduction(factors, ionic): Internal reduction for identity-validated inputs; local(density) and nonlocal_block(left,right) return positive complex atom-major gradients. Not a separate physical state or force convention.
api.h0: Unchanged existing MaterialHamiltonian.apply; no new H0 API or dense PW Hamiltonian.

construction: moments absorbs rectangular C into blocks on the smaller factor leg. Both original PW legs remain complete. The None path uses paired slices without an allocated identity.

PhysicalRhoFFT.from_g reconstructs the existing unnormalized Fourier amplitudes. Density is sum(left_wave*conj(right_wave))/Omega. Local-potential action reuses fft.to_g(field*fft.from_g(block)) with no alternate normalization.

Each moments call accumulates density once across factor blocks. One inverse FFT then supplies all local coordinates through Omega*n(-G)*[-i G_alpha exp(-iG.tau) v_species(G)]. It is the bilinear Fourier transpose, with no density conjugation.

Each species/block shares B†L and B†R over all three axes. Axis derivative overlaps B†(p_alpha L/R) are computed once each and reused across atoms. The two NC sides are i*(B†R)† D B†(pL) and -i*(B†(pR))† D B†L. Neither side is replaced by a real-part/factor-two identity.

D stays species-local. No global projector-space block diagonal, PW-square operator/density, 111 directional full actions per RHS, spin multiplier, symmetry processing or real-part projection is introduced.

Constructor checks placed-projector geometry one atom at a time, sharing existing centered projector cache without retaining duplicate placed projectors. Existing GammaIonicAction directional cache behavior is retained by ionic_action.

findings_and_limits: Complete executable maps and oracle source are delivered, not a callback scaffold. Mathematical/numerical agreement is not claimed before Root runs the newly authored oracle.

The reduction is generic over all original atoms; actual Ni31H6 inputs produce 111 entries. The independent small oracle deliberately uses three atoms/nine coordinates. The separate registered actual-material 37-atom map smoke remains Root-owned and has not been executed here.
No full-PW complement is projected away; selected probe directions do not define a two-ion dynamical truncation.

The constructor relies on existing ordinary-NC/no-NLCC source parsing and table semantics, and adds identity checks rather than independently revalidating pseudopotential physics. Non-Gamma, PAW/USPP, NLCC, SOC/noncollinear and alternate electrostatics are outside scope.

Projector placement identity uses exact equality for the existing deterministic construction from identical source arrays. It deliberately rejects numerically altered/gauge-transformed projectors; no repair or tolerance gate is introduced.

Transient density/overlap work is block-bounded; inputs/outputs, existing species projectors and existing ionic action caches remain material-sized. No measured RSS, wall-time, finite-time integrator, material state or performance guarantee is claimed.

No spin or sector weighting, material D, temperature, baseline force, ionic widths, external holding mechanism, full PBE recalibration, propagation, full BvK or coherence-domain claim is supplied by these operator maps.

Synthetic reciprocal-table metadata in the oracle is explicitly not a material UPF or a new radial quadrature proof. Existing accepted source-physics results remain carried without re-audit or replay.
